passage: Most people picture deserts as places of blazing heat and sand. ______ some of the largest deserts on Earth, including the one that covers nearly all of Antarctica, are extremely cold.
stem: Which choice completes the text with the most logical transition?
steps: Sentence 1: the common picture of deserts as hot.
Sentence 2: some deserts are extremely cold, which goes against that picture.
The others signal a result, likeness or example.
key: If the second sentence corrects or opposes the first, use a contrast transition.
